trust-forecast: Trust sounds like a feeling. It works better as a prediction. From what you have seen so far, you expect a person or a tool to behave a certain way. When new evidence turns up, you change the prediction. Faith asks you to commit without evidence. Trust asks you to commit on evidence that is never complete, and to keep paying attention afterwards. So the aim is not to reach a point where you can stop checking. The aim is to check the things worth checking.
